scenario: My trips tiles are built from the customer's confirmed hotel (Day 2) and dining (Day 3) bookings every time the landing page loads. Nothing about a trip is stored on its own. All data is fictional.
todayNote: Add a debug override for 'today' so the demo can show a tile disappearing the day after checkout.

bookings.note: Confirmed bookings returned by the booking store. Day 2 writes hotel bookings, Day 3 writes dining reservations. 'kesselhorn' is extra seed data so the demo shows two trips.

dinnerHouston.policy: Full refund until Wed, Dec 30, 8:00 PM; after that, the deposit isn't refunded.

seededFlights.note: Seeded with the Houston trip before Day 2 (flight booking isn't in the POC). They appear in the itinerary but never drive tiles, titles or indicators.

rules.group: Put bookings in one trip when their date ranges overlap, counting check-in and checkout day (a hotel is checkIn..checkOut, a dinner is its date). Overlap chains: A~B and B~C make one trip.

title.twoOrMore: Your trip in {city of the hotel, without the state}

rules.destination: City from booking data ({hotel city}, or the restaurant city for dinner-only)
rules.dates: Earliest start to latest end. Dinner-only shows the date and time.
rules.indicators: Stay = the trip has a hotel booking; Dining = the trip has a dining booking. Green with a check when booked, greyed out when not. No Travel or Experience indicators.
rules.order: Upcoming first: sort by start date ascending.
rules.remove: Show a tile through its end date; remove it from end date + 1 day (customer's local date).
rules.none: No bookings: hide the whole My trips section; no empty tile, no prompt.
rules.image: From our destination library by city: Houston → houston, Silver Basin → alpine; fallback beach.
rules.refresh: Fetch bookings and rerun grouping and tile logic on every landing page load.

expectedTiles.refreshExample: Start with dinnerHouston only → 'Your dinner at Osteria Lume'. Add hotelHouston, reload → 'Your trip in Houston' with both indicators green.
expectedTiles.removeExample: With today = 2027-01-03 the Houston tile is gone; Kesselhorn remains.

expectedItineraryHouston.note: Days with nothing booked are left out. Display only.

imageKeys.note: Images already in the project from Day 1 (design/assets).
